releaseNotes:
## Local AI connection

- Fixed thread summaries rejecting Ollama servers on the local network. Local AI now accepts private LAN IP addresses and DNS names, such as http://192.168.1.50:11434 or http://ollama.home:11434.
- Applied the same connection support to email summaries, smart parse and Test connection. An HTTP prefix is optional, and HTTPS endpoints are supported.
- Added clearer connection errors and examples in Settings → Local AI. Addresses must be reachable from the computer running the booking app.
- DNS names are checked against private-network addresses before connecting. Summary cloud-model checks remain in place, and redirects are not followed.
